articles.title: Get Ready for .NET Conf 2026!
articles.summary: .NET Conf 2026 is just one week away! Join us November 10-13 for this free, four-day virtual conference and the official launch of .NET 11.

articles.title: OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra designed a hardware device from scratch in under a week
articles.summary: OpenAI's hardware team used GPT-6 Astra to design a device for the Codex coding agent in under a week, handling everything from the enclosure to the circuit board to the firmware.

articles.title: Claude Code v2.1.318
articles.summary: Added an effort option to a mod's $.model.fork , so a quick side job can run at low whatever effort the session uses; the result reports the effort sent.

articles.title: Morph 4K Firmware v4.0.65
articles.summary: PixelFX have just released a new beta firmware for their Morph 4K that adds more bezel options, as well as the ability to take input screenshots in Universal Adaptive mode.

articles.title: Cat Feeder Ensures Fed Cats
articles.summary: Automatic cat feeders are a dime a dozen, largely because this is an easy problem to solve. Dry cat food is easy for machines to manipulate, and the electronics needed to accomplish the task to a bare minimum are plentiful and inexpensive.

articles.title: macOS 27.3 includes cool-looking ‘Pro’ screensaver from new touchscreen MacBook Pro
articles.summary: Included in today’s macOS 27.3 beta 1 is a great-looking screensaver featuring an animated version of the new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display wallpaper.

articles.title: Introducing Three-Live: turning AI-generated Three.js into interactive 3D, AR, and WebXR across web and mobile
articles.summary: Today, we are excited to release Three-Live ( v1.0.0 , Developer Preview) under the Apache 2.0 license. It’s a lightweight, cross-platform open source library and on-device compiler that bridges the gap between AI-generated Three.js code and high-performance 3D, AR, and WebXR rendering across web, Android, and iOS.

articles.title: Announcing rustup 1.29.3
articles.summary: The rustup team has published a new point release of rustup, 1.29.3. Rustup is the recommended tool to install Rust , a programming language that empowers everyone to build reliable and efficient software.

articles.title: AI inference startup Fal doubles its valuation to $16B as demand surges
articles.summary: Fal , a San Francisco-based startup that hosts and runs AI video, image, and audio models, has raised $1.3 billion in its latest funding round led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with participation from Nvidia, Sound Ventures, and T.

articles.title: Qwen 3.8 27B on my laptop can interpret model weights, too
articles.summary: Yesterday's hot paper was Sparks of Weight-Space Programming: LLMs can natively read & write neural network weights by Rikiya Takehi, Jayden Teoh, Alex Zhang, and Omar Khattab.

articles.title: Everything New in the iOS 27.3 Beta
articles.summary: The redesigned Health app is back in iOS 27.3. It has new Insights and Longevity tabs that show more information about your health and fitness metrics.

articles.title: macOS 27.3 adds native Markdown rendering to Quick Look
articles.summary: Among the smaller changes coming to the Mac is a welcome improvement to Quick Look. As of macOS 27.3 beta 1, .md files are rendered with proper formatting directly in Quick Look, rather than displaying their raw Markdown syntax.

articles.title: Etching Press Aims To Impress
articles.summary: Crank is the right word, because it’s hand-cranked, with the rollers chain-driven off a separate driveshaft. It works like, well, a roller press: two steel rollers squeeze a plattern holding your inked etching and a of paper together to put an image onto.

articles.title: iOS 27.3 brings the iPhone Duo’s revamped StandBy to other iPhones
articles.summary: Apple released iOS 27.3 beta 1 today, with a surprisingly extensive set of new features and improvements across the system. One of them is the expansion of the iPhone Duo’s redesigned StandBy experience to other iPhone models.

articles.title: ‘Cyclon’ uses an old Google Pixel to let AI do literally everything for you – who wants this?
articles.summary: As the AI era continues to find its footing in the consumer market, “Cyclon” is a new smartphone/software experience that, to start, is reusing old Google Pixel phones with a software experience that literally uses AI to do every little thing.

articles.title: Android Auto 18.1 update rolling out with additional prep for light mode and redesign
articles.summary: Google is rolling out Android Auto 18.1 to the masses and, while there are no major changes, the update continues to work on upcoming changes.

articles.title: Game store itch.io is getting flooded with AI slop
articles.summary: The scrappy indie store itch.io is facing a problem - lots and lots of AI slop getting uploaded to it, but they're attempting to fight back against it.

articles.title: BYOK and enterprise custom models in the Copilot usage API
articles.summary: The Copilot usage metrics API now shows bring your own key (BYOK) usage across GitHub Copilot, so you can separate it from Copilot-hosted model usage.

articles.title: iOS 27.3 expands Siri AI to these new languages
articles.summary: iOS 27.3 is available now in beta, and it’s a big release for Siri AI improvements. Joining new app actions, Siri Recaps, and developer features, iOS 27.3 also expands Siri AI to several additional languages.

articles.title: Google confirms something was draining Pixel Watch batteries, fix rolling out
articles.summary: Google reached out to 9to5Google with a statement shortly after the issue showed up, noting it was aware of the problem. Yesterday, it stated that a fix for the Pixel Watch battery drain issue is being rolled out now.

articles.title: SteamVR Beta 2.19.1 is a big upgrade for streaming / Steam Link and Linux
articles.summary: Valve released SteamVR Beta 2.19.1 and especially when it comes to streaming / Steam Link, it seems like a really nice upgrade for picture clarity.

articles.title: Dependabot version updates support Agent Package Manager
articles.summary: Dependabot opens pull requests to update supported git dependencies declared in apm.yml and regenerates apm.lock.yaml when it’s present. This support covers version updates, not security updates.

articles.title: GE-Proton 11-12 is another big release with lots of game fixes for Linux / SteamOS
articles.summary: GE-Proton is one of the most popular community-made Proton layers to run more Windows games on Linux / SteamOS, and GE-Proton 11-12 is now available.

articles.title: Alignment Faking Depends on the Value, Not Just the Model
articles.summary: Language models can follow a directive when they believe they are monitored and abandon it when they believe they are not, a pattern termed Alignment Faking.

articles.title: Look up a resource’s cost center with the GitHub REST API
articles.summary: You can now use the GitHub REST API to find which cost center a user, organization, repository, or enterprise team belongs to. Previously, you had to list every cost center and scan its resources.

articles.title: Check out some of the highest-rated Steam Deck Verified games released in October 2026
articles.summary: Here's some of the highest-rated Steam Deck Verified games released on Steam during October 2026. Helping you find something great to play on the go!

articles.title: CARD: A Proof-Carrying Certificate-to-Action Interface for Relative-Measurement Graphs
articles.summary: Geometric certificates make mathematical claims about specified estimator objects, while robotic action requires a physical transform, a service decision, and timely proof support. We present CARD, a proof-carrying interface that keeps these objects distinct and records how they combine.

articles.title: GitHub Copilot is now available in JetBrains Air
articles.summary: You can now delegate coding tasks, guide execution, and review results with GitHub Copilot in JetBrains Air . The integration uses the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) and supports tasks in your JetBrains IDE or in the cloud.

articles.title: MCPGuard: Finding Conformance Gaps in MCP SDKs via Dual-Track Analysis and Dynamic Adjudication
articles.summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) connects large language model agents to external tools and services through official SDKs that implement message validation and session logic.

articles.title: GIMP 3.2.8 released with improved text tool, performance
articles.summary: GIMP 3.2.8 offers better initial positioning of dialogs, makes the Preferences page load faster and allows the creation of colourful semi-transparent borders via the Add Border filter.
